'''Dihua Jiang''' ({{zh|s=江迪华 |t=江迪華 |p=Jiāng Díhuá}}, born 1958)<ref name="NCKU">{{cite web |url=http://www.math.ncku.edu.tw/research/talk.php?period=2009 |publisher=[[National Cheng Kung University]] |script-title=zh:成大數學系演講公告 |language=zh-tw |access-date=February 29, 2020}}</ref> is a Chinese-born American mathematician. He is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Minnesota]] working in [[number theory]], [[automorphic forms]], and the [[Langlands program]].

==Early life and education==
In 1958, Jiang was born in the [[Lucheng District, Wenzhou|Lucheng District]] of [[Wenzhou]], [[Zhejiang]].<ref name="WMD">{{cite news |url=https://www.yidianzixun.com/article/0NZA1Fgi |language=zh |script-title=zh:数学与家乡——访温籍数学家季理真: 曾经, 中国主要大学的数学系主任1/3是温州人 |publisher=Wenzhou Metropolis Daily |date=October 21, 2019 |access-date=February 29, 2020}}</ref><ref name="China Math Network">{{cite web |url=http://www.china-maths.com/shuxue/news/727.htm |publisher=China Math Network |script-title=zh:温州的骄傲:三位温籍数学家在世界华人数学家大会发言 |language=zh |access-date=February 29, 2020}}</ref><ref name="MoM">{{cite magazine |url=http://www.global-sci.org/v1/mc/issues/2/no2/freepdf/18s.pdf |script-title=zh:六十自述 黎景辉|lang=zh|trans-title=Autobiography: Li Jinghui |publisher=Global Science Press |pages=18–21|magazine=数学文化 [Mathematical Culture] |volume=2 |issue=2 |access-date=February 29, 2020}} See p. 20</ref> He studied at Wenzhou No. 3 Middle School before studying at [[Zhejiang Normal University]], where he received his bachelor's degree in mathematics in 1982.<ref name="WMD"/> He received a master's degree from [[East China Normal University]] in 1987<ref name="WMD"/> and a PhD in mathematics from [[Ohio State University]] in 1994 under the supervision of [[Stephen Rallis]].<ref name="mathgenealogy">{{MathGenealogy|id=10584}}</ref><ref name="WMD"/>

==Career==
Jiang joined the faculty at the Department of Mathematics at the University of Minnesota in 1998 and became a full professor in 2004.<ref name="WMD"/><ref name="Homepage">{{cite web|url=https://math.umn.edu/directory/dihua-jiang |publisher=[[University of Minnesota]] |title=Dihua Jiang |access-date=February 29, 2020}}</ref>

==Awards==
Jiang was a recipient of a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] in 2000,<ref name="WMD"/> was inducted as a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2019,<ref name="AMSFellow">{{cite web |url=https://math.umn.edu/news/dihua-jiang-sasha-voronov-ams-fellows |publisher=University of Minnesota |title=Dihua Jiang Sasha Voronov AMS Fellows |date=November 20, 2018 |access-date=February 29, 2020}}</ref> and was awarded a [[Simons Fellow]] in 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/2024/03/20/2024-simons-fellows-in-mathematics-announced/|title=2024 Simons Fellows in Mathematics Announced|publisher=Simons Foundation|date=March 20, 2024|access-date=2025-05-21}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*Degree 16 standard L-function of GSp(2)×GSp(2). Mem. Amer. Math. Soc. 123 (1996), no. 588, viii+196 pp.
* With [[Ilya Piatetski-Shapiro]]: Arithmeticity of discrete subgroups and automorphic forms. Geom. Funct. Anal. 8 (1998), no. 3, 586–605.
*With [[Wee Teck Gan]] and [[Nadya Gurevich]]: Cubic unipotent Arthur parameters and multiplicities of square integrable automorphic forms. Invent. Math. 149 (2002), no. 2, 225-265.
*With [[David Soudry]]: The local converse theorem for SO(2n+1) and applications. Annals of Mathematics (2) 157 (2003), no. 3, 743-806. 
*With [[David Ginzburg]] and [[Stephen Rallis]]: On the nonvanishing of the central value of the Rankin-Selberg L-functions. J. Amer. Math. Soc. 17 (2004), no. 3, 679–722.
*On the fundamental automorphic L-functions of SO(2n+1). Int. Math. Res. Not. 2006, Art. ID 64069, 26 pp.
*With [[Jian-Shu Li]] and [[Shou-Wu Zhang]]: Periods and distribution of cycles on Hilbert modular varieties. Pure Appl. Math. Q. 2 (2006), no. 1, Special Issue: In honor of John H. Coates. Part 1, 219–277.
*With [[Binyong Sun]] and [[Chen-Bo Zhu]]: Uniqueness of Bessel models: the Archimedean case. Geom. Funct. Anal. 20 (2010), no. 3, 690–709.
*Automorphic integral transforms for classical groups I: Endoscopy correspondences. Automorphic forms and related geometry: assessing the legacy of I. I. Piatetski-Shapiro, 179–242, Contemp. Math., 614, Amer. Math. Soc., Providence, RI, 2014.
*With [[Chufeng Nien]] and [[Shaun Stevens]]: Towards the Jacquet conjecture on the local converse problem for p-adic GLn. J. Eur. Math. Soc. (JEMS) 17 (2015), no. 4, 991–1007. 
*With [[Lei Zhang (mathematician)|Lei Zhang]]: [https://annals.math.princeton.edu/2020/191-3/p02 Arthur parameters and cuspidal automorphic modules of classical groups]. Annals of Mathematics (2) 191 (2020), no. 3, 739-827.
*With [[Baiying Liu]] and Bin Xu: A reciprocal branching problem for automorphic representations and global Vogan packets. J. Reine Angew. Math. 765 (2020), 249–277.
